mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (primary_key, enterprise_code, inspect_main_id, report_main_id, repair_main_id, submit_num, scrap_num, submit_total_num, submit_user_code, submit_date, remark, status, finish_date, batch_no) VALUES (#{data.primaryKeyValue}, #{data.enterpriseCode}, #{data.inspectMainId}, #{data.reportMainId}, #{data.repairMainId}, #{data.submitNum}, #{data.scrapNum}, #{data.submitTotalNum}, #{data.submitUserCode}, #{data.submitDate}, #{data.remark}, #{data.status}, #{data.finishDate}, #{data.batchNo})
mapper.select: select a.primary_key as primaryKeyValue, a.id, a.inspect_main_id, a.report_main_id, a.repair_main_id, a.submit_num, a.scrap_num, a.submit_user_code, a.submit_total_num, a.finish_date from ${tableName} a left join ${dispatcherTableName} b on a.report_main_id = b.report_main_id where a.report_main_id = #{reportMainId} and a.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and a.submit_user_code = #{userCode} and b.operator_user_code = #{userCode} and a.status = #{status} and a.delete_flag = false order by a.id desc
